+class WindowFeatureExtractor:
+    """
+    Reusable extractor for rolling window aggregate features.
+    """
+    def __init__(self, maxlen: int = 10):
+        self.maxlen = maxlen
+        self._buffer_cpu = deque(maxlen=maxlen)
+        self._buffer_gpu = deque(maxlen=maxlen)
+        self._buffer_heat = deque(maxlen=maxlen)
+
+    def reset_state(self):
+        self._buffer_cpu.clear()
+        self._buffer_gpu.clear()
+        self._buffer_heat.clear()
+
+    def update(self, cpu_n: float, gpu_n: float, heat_n: float):
+        self._buffer_cpu.append(cpu_n)
+        self._buffer_gpu.append(gpu_n)
+        self._buffer_heat.append(heat_n)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _get_roll(buffer: deque, window: int) -> float:
+        vals = list(buffer)[-window:]
+        return sum(vals) / len(vals) if vals else 0.0
+
+    def extract_features(self) -> Dict[str, float]:
+        return {
+            'cpu_roll_5': self._get_roll(self._buffer_cpu, 5),
+            'gpu_roll_5': self._get_roll(self._buffer_gpu, 5),
+            'heat_roll_5': self._get_roll(self._buffer_heat, 5),
+            'cpu_roll_10': self._get_roll(self._buffer_cpu, 10),
+            'gpu_roll_10': self._get_roll(self._buffer_gpu, 10),
+            'heat_roll_10': self._get_roll(self._buffer_heat, 10),
+        }
+
